replication.target_description: Study 1 conceptual replication: bivariate Pearson correlation between generalized trust and overall deception detection accuracy; Table 1, variable 1 with variable 2.

p.location: p. 4, Table 1 row 2 column 1 and Results, second paragraph
p.quote: Generalized trust was ... unassociated with detection accuracy using a substan- ... tially larger sample size and stimulus set compared to the ... study we attempted to replicate.

notes: Only pval_value_r is assigned. Table 1 prints r = –.02 and 95% CI [–.16,.13] for generalized trust with overall detection accuracy, without a numeric p. Results describe this association as unassociated. The following sentence gives a collective bound for separately listed truth bias, lie accuracy, and truth accuracy correlations: Generalized trust was ... also statistically unassociated with truth bias, lie accu- ... racy, and truth accuracy (all ps . .571). PDF p. 4 confirms that the canonical OCR dot before .571 represents >. This bound is attached to those three other outcomes, so it is not assigned to the overall-accuracy target. No p calculated from r or N. Unassigned fields are placeholders.
